'''Dolva Prime''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] ambushed [[Edo Strom|Edo]] and [[Rolu Strom]] in the [[Old Hallet prairie/Legends|Old Hallet prairie]] of Dolva Prime in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] in order to recover a fake [[Arachedron sculpture]].<ref name="SWA Boba" />

*''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]'' {{1st}}
